question: Under the unchanged fresh packed-mask endpoint contract, does single_packed_cpu_full_mask_staging preserve contemporaneous stock semantics and reduce H100 service time and sustainable cost?

incorporated_binding.effect: Incorporate the exact model, checkpoint, image, runtime, server geometry, candidate, stock/candidate arms, telemetry, economic gate, budget, deadlines, and prohibitions except the explicitly superseded workload-state clauses below.

superseded_clauses: The prior binding's retained-state assertion that fresh_workload.jsonl and FRESH_WORKLOAD.json were constructed is false and replaced by attempted_but_not_persisted.
The prior prohibition on reconstructing or mutating the constructed workload does not apply because no completion marker or content identity exists.

corrected_atomic_producer.source_rows: Read the first 791 exact_semantic_rows.jsonl rows. Require i exactly 0 through 790, preserve each arrival_s, and require nondecreasing arrivals.
corrected_atomic_producer.template: Select the TRACE_PACKET.json primary_groups row named primary_c1 and its scored[0].request_body. Require a 4214-token prompt and the matched-runner request fields.
corrected_atomic_producer.construction: For source row i, set fresh_index to 61000+i. Reproduce h100_matched_runner.request_body(template, fresh_index) exactly: model google/gemma-4-31B-it; ignore_eos true; min_tokens=max_tokens=358; request_id tail-overlap-{fresh_index}; copied prompt with prompt[535]=200000+fresh_index. Preserve the template's remaining request fields.
corrected_atomic_producer.row_schema: Persist source_i, fresh_index, arrival_s, the complete request_body, prompt_sha256 over compact JSON prompt bytes, and request_sha256 over sorted compact JSON request-body bytes.
corrected_atomic_producer.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with separators (comma, colon), no NaN, one row per line. Prompt hashes use json.dumps(prompt,separators=(',',':')); request hashes add sort_keys=True.
corrected_atomic_producer.novelty: Require fresh indices exactly 61000 through 61790, 791 unique prompt and request hashes, prompt token 535 exactly 261000 through 261790, and no prompt-hash intersection with the same matched template constructed for historical indices 0 through 1035, sentinel indices 60000 through 60003, or any locally persisted consumed prompt hashes.
corrected_atomic_producer.atomicity: Write and fsync fresh_workload.jsonl.part, validate it completely, rename it atomically to fresh_workload.jsonl, then atomically persist FRESH_WORKLOAD.json as the completion marker. The marker must record schema version, status complete, source identities, construction identity, row count, index interval, prompt/request hash-set digests, workload byte SHA-256, and completion UTC.
corrected_atomic_producer.freeze_boundary: Only after FRESH_WORKLOAD.json exists, says complete, and its recorded byte SHA-256 matches may the workload become immutable. A traceback before that marker keeps only this producer step repairable and consumes no scientific sample.

outer_owner.action: Use its repair handshake to transfer the retained claim. Stop only this identity-matched boundary owner when the replacement durable owner has taken over heartbeat responsibility.

owner_transition.replacement: Launch one bounded durable replacement owner in this same project. Its graph must run the corrected producer and proceed directly after the atomic completion marker into exact server launch, stock arm, candidate arm, required telemetry, typed result/terminal, cleanup, and release. Preparation followed by deadline sleep is forbidden.
owner_transition.repair_handshake: An ordinary recoverable launcher or consumer defect may be repaired in place while preserving the claim and completed resident inputs. Do not request another director rebind merely for a mutable path, import, container, or observer correction.

budgets.compute: One retained H100 through the 17:30Z release fence; no checkpoint transfer.
budgets.storage: Reuse the 200-GiB disk and add at most 5 GiB of workload, endpoint telemetry, and result artifacts.

prohibitions: Do not restage or mutate the verified checkpoint, resident packet, exact runtime source, or bound image.
Do not change the model, checkpoint, image, runtime commit, server geometry, arrivals, stock arm, candidate, comparator, telemetry, or economic gate.
Do not read historical response rows as request bodies.
Do not submit historical indices 0 through 1035 or sentinel indices 60000 through 60003.
Do not submit any request until the fresh workload completion marker and all novelty checks pass.
Do not submit any request outside the one stock and one candidate consumption of fresh indices 61000 through 61790.
Do not release, reclaim, reboot, resize, or reprovision the retained bench during this repair.
Do not infer a direct delta to historical request 277.
